description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pyramid of the Pantheon
uses.cardState: with three or more brick counters on it
